value.expected: Wall-clock projection on one box, from the binding ceilings. Setup and downloads share 1,500 s. Controls and the anchor share 1,000 s: the planted 60 s sleep, the empty run and the unit record about 70 s; serial then parallel redocking plus diagnostics about 400 s at the 60 s floor each. Per-pair docking and interface analysis: 600 s ceiling, at most 250 s per pair, 3 pairs. Prediction timings: 2,000 s ceiling, 1,800 s per run at the card's own figure, so 1 to 9 runs; a decision needs 3 completed runs over 3 pairs. Dynamics: 1,600 s ceiling, at most 600 s per complex, 2 to 3 complexes. Storage 20 s to 100 s. Closing stage 100 s. Margin 400 s. The ceilings sum to 7,200 s. Record counts at full sample: 4 input records, 1 anchor record, 3 control records, 1 environment-check record: 9 records. Row lines: 9 prediction runs (3 pairs by 3 seeds), 3 docking rows, 3 dynamics rows, 3 storage rows, 2 control rows: 20 lines. Evidence: 3 pair structures, 3 sequence files, 1 pair-evidence file, 2 anchor rank tables and poses, 3 pair rank tables and poses, 1 byte-for-byte copy of the published structure. Closing files: 1 summary whose first key is the run's scope and whose compute table holds 9 stage entries, 1 validity file, 1 done marker with per-input status and calibration flag, 1 environment note, plus tool logs.
